notes.title: Overlay, Crosshair Resize & XXS Size Added
notes.notes: [p]Overall overlay and crosshair sizes have been resized.[/p][p]XXS size added, and XXL size has been resized larger.[/p][p]Thank you to '도레' for your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Filipino added
notes.notes:
Filipino is now available!
We hope you enjoy it and recommend it to anyone you know who might need it.
Thank you!

notes.title: Bulgarian language available
notes.notes:
Bulgarian is now available in the Languages ​​tab.
Thank you!

notes.title: Added 2XL size & modified Dot size
notes.notes: [p]Double Extra Large (2XL) has been added as the largest size for overlays and crosshairs,[/p][p]and the overall size of Dot has been adjusted to be slightly larger![/p]

notes.title: Indonesian & Thai
notes.notes: [p]Indonesian and Thai are now available for you.[/p][p]Please, recommend this program to your friends in your country![/p]

notes.title: Crosshair position & on/off delay
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where the crosshair was slightly above and to the left of the center.[/p][p]Improved an issue where the crosshair would turn on slightly later when the overlay and crosshair were visible at the same time.[/p]

notes.title: Crosshair Position Fix
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue where the crosshair was slightly above the center of the screen.[/p]

notes.title: UI Scale up to 200%
notes.notes: [p]You can now resize the UI up to 2x, and Arabic has been added.[/p][p]Thanks to [b]lanyu [/b]for the idea![/p]

notes.title: Autorun via Steam
notes.notes: Improved the issue where programs would not launch automatically through Steam when Windows started.
